title: Glass puzzle cube twisting on neon rails
summary: A dark 3x3x3 glass puzzle cube with blue liquid inside rests on diagonal glowing rails, turns single layers, then tumbles and fans its columns apart before re-forming. A wordless hero-object loop for a premium dark brand.
use_when: A wordless hero loop or background plate behind a headline
A dark, blue-accented brand that wants a premium 3D object moment
Visualising assembly, modularity or solving a puzzle without copy
Opening bed under a title card added later

sfx.event: whole cube tumbles about the rail axis
edge glint on a turning column

structure.shot: dark glass 3x3x3 cube with blue liquid inside, sitting on three diagonal blue glowing rails, lower left to upper right
structure.camera: locked-off three-quarter view from above; motion.json s0 pan 0-1 px/s @1920, zoom 0.1 %/s
structure.motion: one horizontal layer turns 90 deg from 0.27 to 0.77 s, ~15 fr (±0.25 s), edge highlights flare at 0.27, smear at 0.50; springs.heavy suggested (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: same cube at rest, liquid inside drifts; a second layer turn mid-row
structure.camera: locked-off; motion.json s1-s3 pan <= 6 px/s, zoom -0.2..0 %/s
structure.motion: hold 1.00-2.00 s; right-hand layer turns 2.27 to 2.77 s, ~15 fr (±0.25 s), springs.heavy suggested; hold 2.77-3.27 s

structure.shot: whole cube tumbles about the rail axis into a diamond pose, edges light up, three vertical columns fan apart, one column spins
structure.camera: locked-off; motion.json s3-s5 zoom -0.2..0.23 %/s, rot 0.15-0.56 deg/s
structure.motion: tumble 3.50 to 4.50 s (~30 fr, ±0.25 s), easings.inOutSine suggested; lit edges at 4.77; columns separated at 5.00; single column turn with glint 5.27, settled 5.50

structure.camera: slow push from 6.00 s; motion.json s6 zoom 0.85 %/s, s7 0.4 %/s
structure.motion: re-form soft at 5.77; tilt 6.00-6.27; column turn with highlight 6.50; top layer turn 7.00; settle 7.27-7.77 (each ±0.25 s), springs.heavy suggested

structure.shot: cube back near the opening pose, seen more frontal and larger, vertical slices turn, then the whole cube rolls again
structure.camera: push-in, motion.json s8 zoom 0.7 %/s, s9 2.7 %/s, pan -9..4 px/s
structure.motion: frontal pose 8.27-8.77; vertical slices 9.00; whole-cube roll 9.27 to 9.77, still moving on the last frame (±0.25 s)

params.brand: brand.json: accent colour drives rail glow and the liquid inside the cubelets; bg near black
params.turns: list of {at, axis, layer, dir} layer quarter-turns; reference: 0.27, 2.27, 5.27, 6.50, 7.00, 9.00 s
params.tumbles: list of {at, frames} whole-cube rolls about the rail axis; reference 3.50 (30 fr) and 9.27 s
params.push: late camera push, zoom %/s (reference ~0.7-2.7 %/s from 6 s on)

notes: One shot, no cuts (cuts.json empty), silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Turn and tumble times read from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); springs and easings are suggestions, overshoot not measurable. Beats: no logo, cta or product appears, so rows inherit hook, and the first whole-cube tumble at 3.50 s is taken as the rhythm break (tension). Not loopable: the last frame is mid-roll. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): puzzle-layer-turn, glow-rails. Needs an R3F glass cube rig the studio lacks.
